dataset: Mumbai Coastal Line, Tidal Benchmarks, and Estuarine Hydrodynamics
source: Survey of India Geodetic Branch / Mumbai Port Authority (MbPA) / INCOIS
crs: EPSG:4326 (WGS84 horizontal), Chart Datum / MSL vertical
spatial_resolution: Vector coastline (< 10m accuracy); Apollo Bunder tidal point observatory
temporal_resolution: Hourly tidal series and real-time harmonic forecasting parameters
coverage: Mumbai Island City, Arabian Sea coastline, and Thane Creek estuarine boundary
limitations: Tidal predictions reflect astronomical forces. Cyclonic pressure drops and wind setup can produce positive storm surges of 0.3m to 0.8m above astronomical tide levels, requiring dynamic coupling with meteorological inputs.
processing: Digitized official high water line and structured Apollo Bunder geodetic datum transformations and historical hourly water-level timeseries.
notes: Directly provides downstream dynamic head boundary conditions for the 1D-2D coupled hydrodynamic nowcasting model.
